title.zh: 环境卫生（撒灰设施——豁免）条例 2021
title.en: Environmental Public Health (Ash Scattering Facility — Exemption) Regulations 2021

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Environmental Public Health (Ash Scattering Facility — Exemption) Regulations 2021 and come into operation on 17 May 2021.

3.—(1) Section 17(1)(a) of the Act does not apply to an individual who deposits, drops, places or throws ashes in an area of the ash scattering facility which is designated by the operator of the facility for that purpose.
(2) Section 17(1)(b) of the Act does not apply to an individual who keeps or leaves ashes in an area of the ash scattering facility which is designated by the operator of the facility for that purpose.
